summary: Half theory, half numericals. Q1 has five short 'Explain' questions of 3 marks each; the rest are small numerical problems (2 to 5 marks) that need a formula, working and a one-line comment. Calculators are allowed.
paper_format: MST Fall 2025: all questions compulsory, answer in sequence. Q1 (5 x 3 = 15 marks) short theory; Q2 to Q6 numericals (2, 3, 3, 2, 5 marks).
question_verbs: Explain with an example and the diagram
Should she ... or should she stop?
marks_structure: 3-mark theory: definition, diagram where relevant, one example
2-mark numerical: one formula and the decision
3-mark numerical: derive, then solve, then interpret
5-mark numerical: full table of working (forecasting, RMSE)
repeated_topics: Utility and the law of diminishing marginal utility
Demand: market demand from individual demand functions, effect of income
Elasticity with the total expenditure method
